title: Jim Ryder tried to transfer UFO to Bigelow

tellings.quote: then you have the speech from Jim Ryder, who's a Lockheed Martin Space Systems guy who we now know tried to transfer a quote-unquote UFO to Bigelow Aerospace in 2008 according to Lou Elizondo, a bunch of other people.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that Jim Ryder, a man from the space division of the aerospace company Lockheed Martin, tried in 2008 to hand over what was called a UFO to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. Michels says this comes from Lou Elizondo, who once ran a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, and from several others. If true, it would mean a major defence company held such an object and tried to pass it on.
